Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological variable is the PTM state (methionine oxidation). The use of 18O-H2O2 is a chemical blocking/labeling step performed during sample preparation to distinguish in vivo oxidation (16O) from in vitro artifacts (18O), rather than a biological perturbation of the living cell. The study focuses on the 'unstressed' state, meaning there is no external biological perturbation applied to the cells themselves.
